senses.gloss: Ujjālaka, name of a lake(?). § 475 (Dhundhumārop.): III, 202, 13530 (samudro vālukāpūrṇaḥ, the abode of Dhundhu).--§ 478 (do.): III, 204, 13588 (samudre vālukāpūrṇe).

Ujjānaka, name of a tīrtha. § 410 (Plakshāvataraṇag.): III, 130, 10552 (esha Uºo nāma Pāvakir yatra śāntavān/ Arundhatīsahāyaś ca Vasishṭo bhagavān ṛshiḥ).--§ 733y (Ānuśāsanik.): By bathing in U. and at the hermitage of Ārshṭisheṇa, and at the hermitage of Piṅgā, one is purified from sins, etc.: XIII, 25, 1741.
Ujjayana, a son of Viśvāmitra. § 721b (Viśvāmitrop.): XIII, 4, 257.
Ujjayanta, a mountain in the country of the Surāshṭras. § 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 88, 8347 (śikharī, description).
